## Audio summary

A male speaker with an English accent, likely in his twenties, is discussing building a custom AI body for a character named Mac. The conversation focuses on the physical components used, such as server motors, a camera, and various parts, as well as the time spent assembling them. There is no music or background sound present in this clip.
## Speech

The speaker says, 'my name is ikehan and this is mac. mac was only able to talk to me, so i gave him a new body now we can observe everything around him track my face and whatever i'm holding for body movements, i use two server motors and the camera from e sp32 s3. i spent a lot of time putting all together because i didn't know that there were gonna be so many ways.'

## Segment summary
A person is shown building and programming a small, white 3D-printed robot, nicknamed "Mac". The segment begins with the physical assembly of the hardware, followed by software development using an AI assistant called Cursor on a Mac computer. The final result is demonstrated: the robot's OLED screen displays different facial expressions in real-time, controlled by a web interface called "face deck" that the user built.
